recommended_edit: No semantics-preserving edit can defeat all survivors by removing the common reduction, because it is an intrinsic consequence of the displayed matrix and fixed frequency values. regression_risk: Adversarial instances aimed at exhaustive DFS could also expose or defeat glm-5, but they cannot restore its incomplete greedy behavior.
